_doc: fc-single-011 (filesystem): delete_file with the single named path. Decoys are read_file and list_directory. The prompt stresses 'leave all other files alone', testing that the model acts on exactly the named file rather than listing or broadening the scope.
prompt: Delete the archived log file /var/log/app/app.log.2023-01-01.gz — it has already been copied to long-term storage. Leave all other files in /var/log/app/ alone.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full text contents of a file at the given absolute path. Returns the file contents as a UTF-8 string, or an error if the file does not exist or is not readable.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to read, e.g. /etc/hostname

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List the names of entries (files and subdirectories) directly inside the given absolute directory path. Non-recursive.

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Delete a file at the given absolute path. Irreversible. Returns an error if the file does not exist, if the path is a directory, or if the caller lacks write permission.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to delete
